correctness.rationale: The circle-of-circumference-k coding floor(t+j alpha) mod k reconstructs the full lift, with one-to-one fibers off Z+alpha Z and two-point fibers on that dense countable set, differing at exactly one site. Irrational rotation yields minimality and unique ergodicity, measure-isomorphism and eigenvalues exp(2pi i m alpha/k). Any automorphism descends to a translation, and preservation of the exceptional fiber orbit restricts it to shift powers plus cyclic symbol additions. Independently, Cyr–Kra proves the same automorphism conclusion via a sharper published bound. There are n Sturmian difference words of length n−1, each permitting k starts, so p(n)=kn. A palindrome must have all increments zero for k>=3; a constant length-n run occurs iff (n−1)alpha<1, yielding P(n)=k for n<=ceil(1/alpha), zero after. The irrational equality endpoint is excluded automatically. Rational finite checks corroborate but do not prove the universal statements.

originality.rationale: A decisive stronger prior theorem covers the main asserted nontrivial automorphism classification: Cyr–Kra (2015), Theorem 1.4, states |Aut(X)/<sigma>|<K when the minimal shift has liminf p(n)/n<K. Here p(n)=kn, so choosing K=k+1 gives at most k cosets, and obvious k inequivalent cyclic alphabet translations give at least k. Hence the advertised complete group Z×C_k is already a direct corollary of the published theorem. The remaining complexity and palindrome counts follow from standard Sturmian factor counts and the elementary reversal 1 versus −1 modulo k. No identical older source for the exact k>=3 palindrome cutoff was proven, but it does not establish independent substantive originality for this combined claimed rigidity theorem.

value.rationale: Automorphism rigidity is a natural valuable invariant for minimal symbolic systems, but for this particular example it is already a short corollary of the exact quotient cardinality theorem of Cyr–Kra. The remaining all-slope word complexity p(n)=kn is standard Sturmian counting after choosing the initial colour; absence of nonconstant palindromes and the cutoff are direct one-local-edge reversal and maximum zero-run deductions. The submitted combination offers a clear explanatory example but, without a new obstruction or independent structural mathematical fact beyond stronger prior work and textbook coding deductions, it does not clear the research-value bar. This rejection does not deny pedagogical use or correctness.
residual_risks: A future independent application of the sharp palindrome cutoff could elevate a different specifically motivated and appropriately scoped claim; none is demonstrated here.
A narrower alternative research claim has not been separately audited or supplied as complete repaired scientific files.
